scenario.action: real engine playthrough: 2 real artifacts present -> cast -> real condition/CDA reads (gap documented)
scenario.result: Gaelicat enters with 2 Artifacts (Phoenix Down, Elixir; confirmed isArtifact()=true/true) already on the battlefield, meeting the printed "two or more artifacts" threshold — but layer-7a effectivePT still reports Gaelicat's unmodified printed 1/3, since this engine has no threshold-gated CDA machinery to apply the printed +2/+0 (a documented gap, same class as scorpion-sentinel/gigantoad's own identically-shaped land-count buffs).
